author: Bobby Grayson
description: The VCS already hands a merge driver the common ancestor, which is exactly the fingerprint needed to tell 'only one side changed this field' from a true collision. Field-level rules: one-sided change wins; metadata merges key-wise; same-field collisions go to the later updated_at; a delete loses to an edit made after it. Per-field files would explode file counts; a stored parent hash duplicates what the VCS knows.
title: Merge driver + field-level 3-way merge, with conflict-marker repair in 'deciduous sync' as the no-config fallback
